thread:
Nina K.: Hey all — final draft of the product launch post is in Google: https://g.co/ri/post-final-v1 PTAL. I did one more pass to tighten the lead and moved the benchmark callout inline for scan.
Priya R.: thanks Nina. Quick ask: we need copy variants for the hero CTA (enterprise vs self-serve). Can we test 'Request enterprise demo' vs 'Start free trial'?
Sam T.: For audiences likely to be enterprise buyers, 'Request enterprise demo' converts better from our past flows. Keep 'Start free trial' lower on the page.
Omar R.: engineering checked the benchmark numbers. Suggest wording: "up to 3x token efficiency and ~40% lower cost per request in our internal tests" — hedged and conservative.
Nina K.: updated to "up to 3x token efficiency and ~40% lower per-request cost in our internal benchmark tests" and added link to detailed benchmark PDF.
Jules M.: design notes: hero image crops on <375px screens. I'll export responsive variants and add a 2x compressed PNG fallback. Also supplied alt: "diagram: request routing, cache layers".
Priya R.: marketing ops checklist: set UTM defaults utm_source=blog, utm_medium=organic, utm_campaign=launch_q2. Hidden form fields: deployment=Hosted|Dedicated|Private, interest_level=trial|demo|info. Map interest_level:demo -> LF queue enterprise; trial -> self-serve funnel.
Nina K.: adding hidden fields now. Draft snippet for the form mapping:
```
hidden_fields: {
  "deployment": "Hosted/Dedicated/Private",
  "interest_level": "trial|demo|info"
}
hubspot: mapping -> contact.deployment_type, contact.interest_level
```
Sam T.: legal flagged the word "guarantee" in the hero. Replace with "aims to" or "designed to". Also remove any direct named references to regulated verticals.
Nina K.: done — swapped to "designed to reduce latency and cost" and replaced sector mentions with "regulated industries".
pub-bot: :information_source: Publishing checklist: legal_approval=false, design_assets=false. Reminder to update CMS flags before scheduled publish.
Jules M.: design assets uploaded to CMS now. Please confirm before publish.
Omar R.: legal_approved? I thought we resolved the claims.
Priya R.: I just pinged legal. @Sam T. confirmed language change — Sam, can you mark legal_approval true in the CMS?
Sam T.: set legal_approval=true and added the legal note in the CMS entry.
Nina K.: great. Proposed publish time: Wed 09:00 PT to catch APAC morning and US early traffic. Webinar: Wed 11:00 PT (live demo + AMA). Need a 60–90m prep window.
Priya R.: assign webinar ops to @Omar R. for infra demo and @Jules M. for slides + visuals. I'll own speaker comms and landing page.
Omar R.: got it. I'll prepare a short infra demo (10 min) and a pre-recorded backup clip.
Jules M.: slides ready, will handoff to Nina for final copy sync.
Nina K.: final QA checklist: design assets uploaded , legal approved , CMS fields set, HubSpot flow LF-3017 created. Once live I'll drop the URL here. :white_check_mark:
pub-bot: :white_check_mark: Publishing checklist: legal_approval=true, design_assets=true, cms_fields=true. Ready to publish.
Priya R.: thanks team — I'll schedule the CMS publish and confirm the HubSpot integration. Will share analytics tags and UTM matrix after publish.
Sam T.: small follow-up: please ensure the benchmark chart is adjacent to the bulleted perf list on mobile (not pushed to the bottom). That drives click-throughs.
Jules M.: adjusted layout. Chart sits next to bullets in mobile breakpoint.
Nina K.: perfect. Final thumbs?
Priya R.: thumbs up from product + legal + design. I'll hit publish tomorrow at 09:00 PT and post the live URL here. :rocket:
